label: D1 after a rare-transition, unrewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2, no reward), later in episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2) and almost only when the reward input is 0 (99.7% of mass). Its specific trigger is the previous trial being a1 with a rare transition to S2 and no reward: prev_common==0 gives 3.7x lift and prev_action==2 gets essentially zero activations. Model-based, this outcome is evidence that S1 is good and the agent should stay with a1. In line with that, activations go with an upcoming a1 choice (policy logit 2.8 to 8) and good==S1, and next-trial switches are nearly absent. It does not fire after rewarded trials, after common transitions, or after a2 trials (rare a2 -> S1 unrewarded included). It is silent in the first ~10 trials of an episode and its rate grows through trials 30-80; adding ep_trial>=30 raised dev F1 from 0.57 to 0.64. Precision is only ~0.56: many matching D1 steps stay silent, which only partly tracks value or reward history (adding a previous-previous reward condition or a value threshold did not help). About 18% of mass sits on the window first trial (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window. A disjunction adding rel -3 D1 with upcoming a1 reached mass recall 0.98 (dev F1 0.65), but it relies on a future/proxy variable, so the simpler fully observed predicate is recorded. Magnitude was not shown to depend on further variables.
